serve.description: `nx serve <app>` — a thin wrapper over the stack-free dev engine (`tools/dev/dev serve <app>`): every process the app declares in `.bespunky/dev.json` (the dev-server; the Firebase emulator suite in a Firebase workspace; anything hand-declared) under ONE graceful Ctrl+C, for the current git worktree or any chosen one (--worktree=<branch|slug|path>), on one port offset for every declared port (--port-offset=auto|<n>: the main tree prefers the base ports, each worktree a stable, verified-free block sized from the declaration), reached at `<slug>.localhost` in the shared co-driven browser (--no-shared-browser to serve headless). --skip=<id,…> leaves processes out (--no-emulators is --skip=emulators; the app then opens with ?emulate=none). Options it does not own are forwarded to the app's primary process (buildTarget, host, proxyConfig, ssl, …); --configuration picks the dev-server's build. --dry-run prints the plan.
